overview: Neferty Space is a decentralized NFT platform on the Internet Computer blockchain. Artists create their own independent collection canisters, mint NFTs with full ownership, and top up fuel (cycles) through a transparent 75/25 payment model. The platform features a cycles health dashboard, bidirectional ICP calculator, multilingual support in 10 languages, and a rich gallery with 3D rating system.
features: Factory/Collection architecture: each artist owns an independent canister
Freemium model: first 10 NFTs free, bonus up to 25, premium beyond
Cycles Management dashboard: health indicator, remaining days and images
Bidirectional ICP ↔ images calculator with live XRC rate
75/25 payment split: 75% cycles for artist, 25% platform fund
10-language support: SK, EN, DE, FR, ES, ZH, JA, AR, PT, RU
3-tab gallery: my collection, standalone, from others
3D NFT rating with color circles and drag-and-drop config
